procedure: Run detailed and minimal closeout validators separately using one batched Git object read per invocation.
scope: v644-v6 logical and committed manifest validation only.
expected: Both validators complete inside their envelopes with all manifest entries and other checks unchanged.
observed: The first batched detailed validator still exceeded its sixty-second envelope because overlapping manifests requested duplicate blobs and an unneeded full status scan remained.
boundary: This validates one process-efficiency method only; it does not weaken scope or establish independent reproduction.
